scope: Checked host core and specified abstract machines; not a complete or kernel-integrated ext4 filesystem

compatibility.scope: host interoperability tests, not formal proof

not_proved: actual runtime gate and device refinement for serialized physical history/reuse
boot/unmount sequencing and full filesystem durability
actual device atomicity, flush, DMA and quiescence contracts
filesystem/namespace operation preservation and runtime authorization
kernel/CortenMM/OSTD/VFS integration and end-to-end filesystem correctness

durable_reserved_window.scope: closed bounded host window; one pending request; atomic 4KiB write, flush-drain, quiescent initial source and no competing writer contracts; no kernel or full concurrent recovery claim
durable_reserved_window.closure_scope: bounded window with retained validated mapping, explicit device contracts and no filesystem/driver claim; see concurrent_window_crash_recovery_closure

concurrent_window_crash_recovery_closure.scope: bounded closed host journal window with retained validated mapping; one pending request; no mounted filesystem or hardware claim
contract_premises: quiescent initial device matches retained snapshot
successful flush drains earlier issued writes
fresh recovery attempt starts from quiescent crash/reset snapshot
